items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: they had a band playing like Glenn Miller, and then you'd go to another club and you'd hear Benny Goodman, and you'd have Woodie Herman, and they played like them, you know? They played all their arrangements; they could, they could copy anything.

ctx.x: Yeah, it was always Buddy Cole who would always play the things on ... that was when we went to the Orient, it was quite a good experience; we did an hour and a half television show there, and it's funny how the language, you know, with music, language is no barrier. They just -- in Japan, they really loved him, you know, he was singing all these love songs, and they know every song that he would sing. He would start -- he would sing "Unforgettable", the house would come down, just like it would here, you…
But they didn't have anybody singing like Nat, did they?
